title: Google Vertex AI · 定价来源更新
summary: 调整 tuned model 端点定价规则：从统一 1.5 倍改为区分全球区域（同价）和非全球区域（1.5 倍），并明确适用于 Gemini 3 及之后模型。

added_lines: * For model inference starting from Gemini 3, tuned model endpoint prediction price will be 1.5 times of the base model in non-global region. Tuned model endpoint has the same prediction price as the base model in global region. Old Gemini models prediction price stays the same as the base model.
* Tuned model endpoint will be 1.5 times of the base model in non-global region. Tuned model endpoint has the same prediction price as the base model in global region.
removed_lines: * For model inference starting from Gemini 3, tuned model endpoint prediction price will be 1.5 times of the base model. Old Gemini models prediction price stays the same as the base model.
* Tuned model endpoint will be 1.5 times of the base model.
